info.title: VideoConference API
info.description: ASP.NET Core Web API for Video Conferencing with LiveKit WebRTC, Microsoft SQL Server, and Clean Architecture.

get.summary: Get all registered users (Admin only).

put.summary: Deactivate a user account and immediately revoke access (Admin only).

get.summary: Get all meetings across the platform (Admin only).
Get complete global audit history logs (Admin only).
Get overall platform statistics (total users, meetings, recordings) (Admin only).

post.summary: Login and obtain an application JWT access token and refresh token.
Refresh an expired or expiring access token using a valid refresh token.
Log out the currently authenticated user and revoke refresh tokens.

get.summary: Get current authenticated user profile.

put.summary: Update current authenticated user profile or password.

get.summary: Overall health status check.
Liveness probe: responds if the Web API process is running.
Readiness probe: responds if the Web API can connect to database.

post.summary: Send an invitation to a meeting by recipient email.

get.summary: List invitations sent for a meeting.

post.summary: Accept a meeting invitation using the invitation token.
Create and schedule a new meeting. Generates a unique LiveKit room and public link.

get.summary: Get all meetings hosted or joined by the current user.
Get upcoming and active meetings for current user.
Get meeting details by ID.

put.summary: Update meeting metadata (Host or Admin only).

delete.summary: Delete a meeting (Host or Admin only).

get.summary: Look up meeting information by its public meeting link token (for join landing page).

post.summary: Join a meeting. Validates status, password, and bans, then generates and returns the LiveKit participant JWT.
Leave a meeting and update participant presence status.
End a meeting for all participants (Host, CoHost, or Admin only).

get.summary: Get meeting history logs for current user across meetings.
Get audit history logs for a specific meeting.
Retrieve stored chat messages for a meeting.

post.summary: Save a chat message for archival/persistence.

get.summary: Get list of notifications for the current user.

post.summary: Mark all notifications as read for current user.

get.summary: Get the list of participants for a meeting.

post.summary: Remove a participant from the meeting (Host, CoHost, or Admin only).
Ban a participant from re-entering the meeting (Host, CoHost, or Admin only).
Promote a participant to Co-Host role (Host, CoHost, or Admin only).
Demote a Co-Host back to regular Participant role (Host or Admin only).
Start recording the meeting (Host or Admin only).
Stop active recording for the meeting (Host or Admin only).

get.summary: List recordings metadata for this meeting.
Search meetings by title/description and users (if Admin).

Example: "Bearer eyJhbGciOi..."
